shared_recipe.backend: ANGLE SwiftShader according to receipt-bound capture policy

methods: Viewed every original detail and wheel PNG directly.
Compared visible geometry/material identity across each pair; checked frame edges, nonblank content, transparent background and intentional ceiling mount.
Examined low-alpha support/shadow behavior composited onto a light neutral gallery background; diagnostic composites are not replacement source assets.

Independently verified ZIP size/digest, unique 15-file entry set, extraction byte equality, receipt PNG SHA/size/dimensions, source GLB bytes, parent accepted card hashes, current import rows/seals, exact shared recipe and per-asset input keys.
Validated finite wheel zoom/offset, 16:9 aspect, projected bounds inside the frame, azimuth 42, accepted elevations 23.3 or 40, and 48 finite floor samples as framing metadata.
Compared old 194 model objects, poster rows, 399 resource seals and actual resource bytes to the exact Git baseline; checked the same eight stale input seals remain inherited.

checks.visual_observations: Slender brown trunk and sparse branching greenish twig sprays are recognizable in both views. Trunk foot and branch tips remain fully within the frame.
checks.per_asset_limits: The fine branch silhouette is intentionally sparse; a static image does not demonstrate branch connectivity at every occluded point.

checks.visual_observations: Tan paired oval valves, dark stalk eyes and antennae, paired swimming flaps, and forked terminal tail read as the same bounded organism in both views. The 40-degree wheel view exposes the body without cutting appendages.
checks.per_asset_limits: Some paired limbs and the far valve overlap naturally at these viewpoints; hidden anatomy and motion are not established.

checks.visual_observations: A pale sand-colored crescent body and two tapering horns are legible in both views. Both tips are intact; the higher wheel viewpoint preserves the crescent silhouette.
checks.per_asset_limits: Pale preset lighting gives low internal contrast, especially on the detail image. This is nonblocking at the supplied size; neither wind direction nor terrain-scale behavior is tested.

checks.visual_observations: A tan rectangular sediment slab carries a readable train of parallel asymmetric ridges. The end profiles and higher wheel view reveal the ripple relief; all slab corners remain in frame.
checks.per_asset_limits: Fine relief has intentionally subdued tonal contrast. No hydrodynamic simulation, scale validation, or live scene interaction is inferred.

checks.visual_observations: A blue-gray faceted boulder with a pale cross-cutting vein sits on an ochre support slab. Shape, vein and support colors continue coherently across detail and wheel; no face or base is clipped.
checks.per_asset_limits: Viewpoint occludes the rear boulder surface. A static presentation does not prove geologic provenance or contact behavior.

checks.visual_observations: Off-white curled ribbon-like radial petals rise from a small brown rock base. The large upper curl, lateral curls and negative spaces are visible and fully in frame in both views.
checks.per_asset_limits: The dense center and rear curls overlap naturally. The review does not certify every hidden ribbon junction or mineral growth accuracy.

checks.visual_observations: Ochre ceiling slab supports downward-pointing hanging pendants in both views. The long central tip is intact. The slab remains above the pendants, not flipped into floor-standing stalagmites.
checks.per_asset_limits: Several pendants are viewpoint-occluded. A soft preview support/shadow plane is present, but is not a cave floor or evidence of an installed scene. Ceiling-mounted intent is preserved; no physical hanging/load or scene placement test is claimed.

baseline_limitation.required_parent_action: Integrate these seven additions onto the separately validated 217-model baseline without replacing or re-signing inherited rows, then rerun complete-gallery and final publication checks for the intended 224-model result.

nonblocking_observations: Pale barchan and ripple surfaces have subdued internal contrast under the approved preset, but silhouettes and defining relief remain readable.
Very low-alpha support-shadow RGB can look noisy in a raw transparency preview. Light-background composition is clean; this is not an opaque background patch or geometry corruption.
Some soft low-alpha support shadows approach canvas edges. The opaque model bounds remain strictly inside every frame, corroborated by direct pixel inspection.
limits: This report approves only the seven supplied static gallery detail/wheel pairs and their exact local integration identity.
The immutable producer receipt correctly retains independent_pixel_review=pending; this separate independent report supplies scoped QA rather than rewriting producer evidence.
Parent card continuity means identical pinned source GLBs and unchanged accepted card bytes plus consistent visible model/material features, not pixel equality between card and gallery renderers.
Wheel metadata is framing evidence only; it does not prove runtime scrolling, rotation, hit testing, interactive wheel behavior, or physical ground contact.
No physical-GPU validation, target-scene verification, scientific reconstruction certification, formal candidate acceptance, final CI, main-branch merge, or live publication is claimed.
Formal acceptance remains BLOCKED. All-201 gallery completeness is false because of eight unchanged inherited stale input seals. The final 217-to-224 integration is outside this review.
